posts.body:
Hiya,

Can anyone help me and recommend where I can buy cheap (ish) Fleece Sleepsuits for my 16 month old please?

I have tried Asda, Tesco, Argos, Toys r us, Mothercare, all the usual places and not a lot a choice, if any.

I have looked on ebay and am watching a couple.

I'm usually more organised and buy them in them in the last sales ready for this winter, but totally forgot :wall:

Any one know of any offers on at shops/online that have a good range that's not too pricey please?

Many Thanks.

Also need an all-in-one coat/snowsuit, that I also forgot to get :wall: so looking for 1 of these also. Living near the sea, it gets Very cold n windy.

posts.body:
I have been after fleece sleepsuits reasonably prices its not easy is it. I think i will go back to primark i thought £8 was pricey but since i have looked elsewhere its definitely cheap! M and S had lovely ones but £16 each!.

I have won a couple on ebay this week so hopefully they are ok. One was velour which is normally quite snuggly. Have you thought about velour? I have also won 3 toddler sleeping bags week after doing a local to me search so no postage (checked with seller before bidding).

I am just going to look out for a baby snowsuit on facebook selling groups i have seen a few being sold lately but have been a little slow in seeing them and they have sold to quickly. Might try a wanted post instead. They seem to go £4-£8 2nd hand.
